meta.title: Add Todo Item
meta.description: A checkers-themed 'Add Todo Item' form. The full canvas is covered by a red-and-black checkerboard pattern, with a black header bar at the top reading 'Add Todo Item' in white. A white form panel sits centered on the board, flanked at its four corners by checker-piece style concentric circles (alternating red and black). Inside the panel is the label 'What needs doing?', a text input pre-filled with 'Buy milk', and a red 'Add Item' button styled like a checkers piece, flanked by a black and a red checker-piece decoration.
